properties.displayName: Audit resources without diagnostic settings sent to Log Analytics
properties.description: A resource whose logs are not collected is a resource you cannot debug and cannot audit. This is Audit rather than DeployIfNotExists deliberately: automatically enabling every log category on every resource is a reliable way to multiply an ingestion bill overnight. The correct response to a finding here is a considered decision about WHICH categories matter, which is what each Terraform module already encodes.

metadata.rationale: Audit-only on purpose. See docs/architecture/07-observability.md on the cost of indiscriminate log collection.
